title: Material-dependent effects of injectable platelet rich -fibrin on growth factor release, inflammation, and osteoclast activity: an in vitro study
authors: Ievina L, Della Bella E, Micko L, Salma I, Sieberath A, Dubnika A. BMC Oral Health. 2026 Jan 16;26(1):270. * collacone®
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “i-PRF showed different synergetic responses based on collagen and calcium phosphate composition in materials it was combined with. Meaning that these findings provide guidance for optimizing biomaterial and i -PRF combinations in surgical applications and inform the design of next-generation PRF-material composites” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
